findings.title: `stash eql upgrade --eql-version 3` (or install --force) drops customer columns typed with eql_v3 domains
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified: upgrade.ts calls installer.install for v3 with no check for dependent columns, and the v3 bundle drops the eql_v3 schema (which holds the column domains) with CASCADE.

findings.title: v3 Supabase filters put full ciphertext envelopes and all index terms in GET URLs
findings.label: valid
findings.note: encryptCollectedTerms uses encrypt() and stringifies the full envelope (ciphertext plus all index terms) as PostgREST GET filter values, as the code comments admit.

findings.title: v3 `like`/`ilike` silently return no or partial rows with default match options or `%` patterns
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Encrypted like/ilike become cs on a full envelope and defaultMatchOpts sets include_original:true, which the code itself says makes substring patterns match only exact values.

findings.title: protect-ffi 0.27 bump changes v2 behaviour for existing users
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculative FFI v2-compat concern; the finding itself admits it cannot be checked, and no cited code shows a change in v2 behaviour.
